title: Student Counsellor — UK and Ireland
content:
Three or more years in student counselling, with direct experience of UK admissions. You will carry your own caseload from first consultation through to pre-departure.

Dhanmondi, Dhaka, Full time. Send a CV and a short covering note explaining why this work interests you. We read the covering note first.
